ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a “Leaf shapes” schematic diagram, showing multiple lettered leaf-shape outlines and leaf examples (A to H). Reasoning: The question asks which kind of leaf is like a top (spinning top). The leaf-shape category that matches this kind of wide round upper part and narrow lower-end outline is “Top shaped”.
